name: Should I replace my window trim when I replace my windows?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace my window trim when I replace my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is generally recommended to replace window trim when you replace your windows. New windows often have different frame depths or require new flashing details, making existing trim incompatible or inefficient. Replacing the trim simultaneously ensures a perfect fit, optimal sealing against weather elements, and a clean, updated aesthetic. This approach also allows for a comprehensive inspection of the rough opening and surrounding areas, addressing any potential issues before new trim is installed, providing a complete and durable solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, it's recommended to replace trim with new windows to ensure a perfect fit, optimal sealing, updated aesthetics, and to address any underlying issues.
